stories.title: Token Schema and Validation Contract
stories.description: Define canonical bearer token schema (hashed_token_id, issued_at, expires_at, scope, status, rotation_parent_id) and strict validation contract including signature verification, expiry enforcement, scope validation, and revocation checks aligned with shared brain_auth patterns.

stories.title: Core Token Lifecycle Engine
stories.description: Implement lifecycle engine covering secure issuance, expiration enforcement, atomic rotation (invalidate prior token on issue), and revocation with constant-time lookup to ensure performant validation under load.

stories.title: Internal Token Management Interfaces
stories.description: Expose internal-only service interfaces (issue_token, validate_token, rotate_token, revoke_token) for GPTReader, Azure Functions, and pipelines with strict contract adherence and no external/public API exposure.

stories.title: GPTReader Lifecycle Enforcement Integration
stories.description: Integrate token validation into GPTReader request pipeline enforcing signature, expiration, revocation, and scope checks with fail-fast rejection and audit-safe error handling.

stories.title: Token Lifecycle Test Suite
stories.description: Develop unit and integration tests covering issuance, expiration, rotation, revocation, replay attack prevention, invalid signature handling, and GPTReader enforcement paths.
